_comment: ONE required check (2026-07-27). secret-scan and dep-audit used to be separate jobs in security-gates.yml; they are now STEPS of typecheck-test — same detectors, same blocking behaviour. 2026-08-01: every job moved from the single self-hosted runner to fresh GitHub-hosted runners (repo is PUBLIC — free, 20-job concurrency). duplication-gate still runs and still goes red, but is deliberately NOT required: it was de-required 2026-07-02 (flaky at token boundaries, blocked BET-57/PR#27, and agents cannot rerun CI). It is a judgment signal the PM and reviewer read. (The Electron+Xvfb E2E Smoke Test job was removed from ci.yml — it was flakier than the deterministic gates; scripts/check-e2e-smoke.sh stays runnable locally.) THIS FILE MUST STAY IN SYNC with the main branch ruleset's required contexts (Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> main) — they are two separate places, and requiring a context no job produces blocks every PR forever. Change the ruleset FIRST, then this file.
